title: Availability zones fail together more often than brochures
body: Zones in one region share regional control planes, and sometimes power grids, weather and network fate. The industry learned through incidents that multi-AZ is not multi-region: a regional control-plane fault can impair every zone's management at once even while workloads run. True isolation must be audited at the level of shared dependencies, not counted in zone names.
source_hint: Cloud provider postmortems; AWS architecture literature
